'''Taepalae''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the leader of a small group of salvagers on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

She met [[Meetra Surik]] near the ruined [[Jedi Enclave]] after one of her companions, [[Jorran]], had been trapped in a room after they all had been attacked by [[laigrek]]s, forcing all but Jorran to leave the Enclave.

When Surik rescued Jorran, Taepalae recommended Surik accept a reward the next time she saved someone's life.

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Exile might provoke Taepalae and her companions to a fight by insulting them during the conversation of their first encounter. This results in a dark side shift for the Exile.
